column1: # templates/requirements.tsv — the GPU budget each curated template needs, in GiB.
# A template is installed only when the card's measured total memory is >= min_gib AND every model
# file the graph names is present in the state volume (select-templates.py). The number is the
# DECLARED budget for the graph's model set — the sum of the weights it loads plus headroom — not a
# measurement of peak use; it exists so an un-runnable template never reaches the Templates dialog.
# A template with no row here aborts the install: unclassified is not the same as "fits".
# The experimental 14B Wan pair (two ~13 GiB UNETs) is deliberately above every card this pod runs
# on; it stays listed here so the decision is explicit rather than a silent omission.
